Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypts files using strong encryption (RSA and AES keys)
Distributed via spam email campaigns with ZIP attachments containing HTA files
HTA files use double extensions (e.g., PDF.HTA, DOC.HTA) to trick users into execution
HTA extracts and runs a Javascript file and a randomly named executable that encrypts files
Also extracts and runs a corrupted DOCX file to mislead users
Targets specific file extensions for encryption
Deletes shadow volume copies, disables Windows Startup Repair, and modifies boot status policy
Adds ransom note and .KEY file to user folders
Ransom payment site with modular purchase options and synchronization of .KEY file
Attack Vector: Spam email campaigns with malicious ZIP attachments containing HTA files
Indicators of Compromise: Spam email subjects and senders (e.g., ООО Велунд Индастриел, Ltd. Volund Indastriel)
Attachment names: СЧТ. по заявке_КвитанцияDOC.zip, SCORE. Receipt of the application DOC.zip
HTA file names: Скан-копия _ 10 января 2017г.  Составлено и подписано главным  бухгалтером. Экспорт из 1С.a0 1e743_рdf.hta
Public RSA key embedded in executable
Ransom note filename format: [Infection-ID].HTML with infection ID format CCCXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX or CCXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX
